current.text: He is projected to start for Golden State next to Curry, Lendeborg, Green and a center.
The experts expect him to start and to play over 30 minutes per game. Steve Kerr likes him.
Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season. Moses Moody is out at the start of the season.
Golden State has very poor depth and no shot creator besides Curry, so his role is secure on a thin team.
He finished 136th last season. Late in the season he played 32 minutes and ranked 61st after the All-Star break.
Josh expects a likely top 100 season, with about 20% usage and gains in threes, rebounds, steals, assists and points.
With Butler out he could handle the ball more and have a strong early run of assists. His potential assist conversion is only 47%.
He would gain value if Steph Curry gets hurt.
The ESPN rank of 66 is too high. His Yahoo rank around 116 to 120 is good value, more so in category leagues, and he is fine around pick 100.
He is the best Warriors target for the speaker in the team preview.
Golden State may treat this as a gap year and is worried about lottery odds.
He should start the season well, but one expert expects Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs ending March 28 but has 15 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He tends to start seasons slowly and has struggled in the playoffs.
His category profile is balanced with no weak category. Rebounding is his best category compared with other guards.
Steve Kerr runs unpredictable rotations and often changes a set starting lineup after a few games.

note: Yahoo values him at 1 USD with rank 117, ESPN at 7 USD with rank 66, and nobody drafted him in our league last season. The experts like him near Yahoo's price as a late, low-cost starter and warn against paying ESPN prices. He played 82 games last season, ranked 61st after the All-Star break, and has no weak category, so he fits any build. Early in the season, check that he starts and plays 30 or more minutes, and watch his assists while Butler is out.
